zh-CN.title: 语音消息与歌手气泡
items: 听语音时可以继续滑动聊天记录，离开会话时自动停止。
歌手语音沿用各自的气泡配色，展开转写时唱片留在语音旁。

en.title: Voice messages and artist bubbles
items: Voice messages keep playing while you scroll and stop when you leave the conversation.
Artist voice messages match their bubble theme, and the record stays beside the audio when you open the transcript.
